reviewItem.question: Does "ACME Certificate Profiles: cert-manager now supports the selection of ACME certificate profiles, allowing users to request different categories of certificates…" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cert-manager|name=acme-certificate-profiles (added)?

proposed.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 adds support for selecting ACME certificate profiles (e.g. tlsserver, shortlived) when requesting certificates from an ACME CA.
